knowledge.purpose: Shows the app's own map picture (an SVG or image in its media: a venue plan, a campus, a neighbourhood drawn for the app) with a marker for each named location placed on it; the chosen one is highlighted and a chip row picks between them. Nothing is fetched from a tile server or any other origin.
useCases: Venue, campus or office map drawn for the app, with its entrances and stops
A route's stops on a drawn line map
antiPatterns: Not a GIS or routing tool, and not a street map: it draws the app's own picture only — for real directions link out to a maps app
Placing markers by latitude/longitude — a position is x/y in % of the picture
Leaving the address only on the map — write it out as text as well

jsonSchema.description: The map picture: a path in the app's own media ("pwpack/media/venue-map.svg"). An absolute URL or another origin is refused.
What the picture shows, in the app's words ("Map of Example Hall and the stops nearby"): the map's accessible name.
The picture's width (its viewBox width for an SVG). With imageHeight it sets the box's proportions before the picture loads. Unset: 4:3.
The picture's height (its viewBox height for an SVG).

props.name: locations

x.description: % of the picture's width from the left

y.description: % of the picture's height from the top

props.description: Locations, each { label, address?, x?, y? }. Every location with x/y (in % of the picture) is a marker; the chips select one, which is highlighted. A location without a position is a chip only; with no picture the chosen location's address is shown instead.
